name: pi-gentle-skill-ownership

pi.dual_visibility_reason: Current Gentle AI and Gentle Shell upstreams diverge functionally for these skills; hiding the shared copies could remove behavior not present in the Pi bundle.

rules: Do not delete an owner-managed runtime store merely because another runtime can also discover ~/.agents/skills.
Use official gentle-ai sync for Gentle-managed OpenCode/Codex assets.
Use exact Pi force-excludes only for shared duplicates whose Pi bundle authority is accepted.
Do not force-exclude issue-creation or work-unit-commits until their upstream divergence is reconciled and released.
Project-specific skills belong in the target repository rather than hidden global legacy stores.
